actions.outcome: Validates Response. On failure: red ring, "Response is required.", focus in the box. On success: trims, stores it as the message's response, stamps Replied At with the current browser time (now()), re-renders the table, closes, toast Reply sent to {name}.. Resending overwrites the earlier response and time; no history. Nothing is actually emailed in the prototype although the placeholder says "Type the reply the citizen will receive"
